DefaultDialogue: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" priority="high" />It is very hard to believe this dismal forest was once a happy place. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />So much that was good is gone.

<g id="female_gesturearoundroom" priority="high"/> I hoped time would bring new life to Brightwood, <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />but it remains as dreary as it was two centuries ago.
<g id="male_converseright" />Many of the king's knights joined the Order… <g id="female_leanforwardSmall" />but of course, you know what happened to them.
<g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Ah, it is good to see you, young Warden. <g id="male_apologizesmall" />I have bad news - I found a large force of Corrupted to the east.
<g id="female_nodyes" />If you can defeat their Commander, it will weaken the Corrupted's hold here.
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have arrived just in time, young Soulwarden. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I was becoming quite concerned.
<g id="male_sighRelief" />Hm. I feel guilty saying it, but I am relieved to see the knight depart. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />He clings to his ignorance with unwavering assurance.
<g id="male_hopeless" />In my most dire estimations, <g Id="female_disappointed" priority="high"/>I could not have imagined how desperate the situation has become.
<g id="male_willcoverit" />I am going to focus every moment on recruiting new Soulwardens. One thing is certain - we cannot do this alone.
<g id="male_willcoverit" />I am going to focus every moment on recruiting new Soulwardens. One thing is certain - we cannot do this alone.
<g id="male_bowShallow" />Welcome back, Warden. <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />If I had known the difficulty in claiming the fortress, I might've thought twice.
<g id="male_bowShallow" />Welcome back, Warden. <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />If I had known the difficulty in claiming the fortress, I might've thought twice.
If this works, I think we'll have a fine fortress for the new Order.
<g id="female_gestureforward02" />You, on the other hand, have no such luxury. <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />You've been quiet, but I can tell the voice of the Tempest still speaks to you.
More and more brave young souls join our ranks each day.We may yet return to the numbers we had so long ago.
<g id="yonas_bowShallow" />Travel safely, friend. While in the Brightwood, I suggest you stay on the road and avoid traveling at night.

<g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" />Be wary, traveler. A great tragedy has occurred here.<g id="yonas_gestureAround" priority="high"/> The good people who lived in these hills have fallen and turned into soulless Lost.
<g id="yonas_headnodyes" />Yes, friend. You are now acquainted with <g id="yonas_shakeheadWorried" />my regretful decision to abandon Umberto and go on a fruitless quest to find the king.
<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />What matters most, however, is that we're united in seeking Brother Umberto.
<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />What matters most, however, is that we're united in seeking Brother Umberto.
Glad you're here - the old man seems quite disturbed, but your presence will reassure him.
Glad you're here - the old man seems quite disturbed, but your presence will reassure him.
Have no fear. If I find Umberto, you will be first to know.
<g id="male_gestureLeft" />I have been inquiring around town whether anyone here was a witness to the Vigil's fall.
<g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" priority="high"/>I'm afraid I haven't been quite so successful. The only thing I've learned is that Umberto hasn't been seen for years.
<g id="female_nodding" />I will go and speak to the Mayor myself. <g id="female_youknows" />In the meantime, it would seem there are still questions as to Umberto's ultimate fate.
<g id="male_spreadarms001" />Fortuitous timing, my friend. You catch me on the verge of <g id="male_pointleft" />traveling into Weaver's Fen to inquire about Umberto.
I have not visited the Fen since the Wars of Crimson Madness. Those are not fond memories.
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />After all we've learned, I presumed Umberto had long since fallen Lost. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />It would have been a just fate, but no.
<g id="male_apologize" />I… must apologize. I judged the Wardens unfairly, perhaps during the Crimson Madness, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but most certainly now.
<g id="male_apologize" />I… must apologize. I judged the Wardens unfairly, perhaps during the Crimson Madness, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but most certainly now.
I've given the matter some thought, and I decided to take you up on your offer.
<g id="female_spreadarms" />It seems providence has already seen fit to verify I made the right choice in coming.
We were so naïve when we arrived on these shores.We actually believed this accursed island held the promise of Avalon.
<g id="female_spreadarms" />Always a treat to see a new face in Calvary, but <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I have no time to talk right now. It's quite taxing to run this town, you know.
God's ears! <g id="male_whattheheckbig" priority="high" />Tell me you're not here to talk about missing priests, cursed forts, or the damned Bright Vigil.
<g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />Now I've already told you more than I should have. Let me be!
<g id="female_blameShort" />I see that look in your eye… whatever you found up there, <g id="male_whatwantfromme" />I had nothing to do with it!
<g id="male_giveup" priority="high"/>If you wish to see me punished for my silence, I accept it. I have nothing to say in my defense.
<g id="male_whatwantfromme" />You again? No, please! I have nothing more to confess! You've already exposed my secret shame!
Go on, read the book, though it might give you a fright!
<g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />There now, you know the full story! Whatever terrible deeds you attribute to the Bright Vigil, they were victims too.
I thought you were going to Weaver's Fen… good riddance, I say!
Go on now. I'd rather not linger in this place too long.
<g id="grace_spreadarms" />Well now, imagine finding the only other sane person on this island, <g id="grace_gesturel" />here in this accursed place!
<g id="grace_excited2" />Now we're talking… I see you found some shinies. Don't forget - <g id="grace_takeItem5s" priority="high"/>all this is going toward buying a boat to get off this crazy rock.
Go on now. I'd rather not linger in this place too long.
Well now, we got a right crowd hanging about this place.
<g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Even shrouded in darkness, there is beauty in Brightwood. <g id="male_agree1" />If you know where to find it.
<g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />If the mayor sent you to nag me about his invitation to tea, please give him my regrets.
I have my part in this as well. I'll explain after Brightrest.

<g id="male_handsHipsConsider"/>Removing the curse from Caer Dun will take more than just seeing the Vigil's crimes avenged. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />We'll need the healing power of the earth itself.
<g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />There is something… different about you, I think. You were <g id="male_think" />touched somehow by the Tree, weren't you?
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />Whatever you have to face down there, I have no doubt you can handle it.
<g id="female_chuckle" />You were just in time to interrupt Yonas sharing another tale of your exploits. <g id="female_fingerwagno" />Not that I wasn't enjoying them, of course.
<g id="female_chuckle" />You were just in time to interrupt Yonas sharing another tale of your exploits. <g id="female_fingerwagno" />Not that I wasn't enjoying them, of course.
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />Whatever you have to face down there, I have no doubt you can handle it.
<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" priority="high"/>I must admit, I really wasn't sure this would work, but look at this place!
<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" priority="high"/>I must admit, I really wasn't sure this would work, but look at this place!
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />If I'm being honest, I'm a bit jealous of you getting a vision from the Azoth Tree.
I will stay here and help Yonas. I think he needs it.
